finalText:
Builds clean now. `src/core/settings.js` had a `ReferenceError` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which crashed the link stage every time.

Fixed it to fall back to a `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` constant of `3` when the caller doesn't pass one. The build now finishes: `build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors`, exit code 0. Those 3 warnings are just noise (a deprecated API, an unused export, a circular import) — none of them block the build, so I left them alone unless you want those cleaned up too.
